تغتدوا (form VIII)
# تَغْتَدُوا (taḡtadū) /taɣ.ta.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# تُغْتَدَوْا (tuḡtadaw) /tuɣ.ta.daw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
